::: {.entry-meta}
[bug fix]{.chip .fixed} Entry 55 · milestone M4
:::

The first richer signed-heat diagnostic stopped after its initial control case.
The native solve produced full-precision output, but paired reporting tried to
read an error-status register that the compiled in-memory wrapper does not expose.
That field exists in the Fortran interface source, which does not guarantee it
is part of the compiled Python interface. The failed attempt and partial evidence
are retained; the diagnostic collection was incomplete.

The reporting code now queries actual capabilities. It explicitly records absent
status, checks finite returned fluxes, preserves signed species values and retains
any reported failure status where available. It does not manufacture a successful
status or independent convergence evidence. Three synthetic worker checks cover
those cases without calling the physical solver.

| evidence | result |
|---|---|
| focused capability regressions | [25 diagnostic checks pass in each mode, including unavailable status, exposed failure status and nonfinite output; 33 unchanged focused checks are retained for 58 focused recorded passes per mode]{.claim}[C-198](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-198){.cid .st-tested} |
| original collection | failed and retained; no completion claim |

A new immutable request follows the diagnosed fix. It keeps the same cases,
settings and hard allocation limits and is covered by the owner's bounded-run
permission. It is not a repeat of the consumed source package. New package
summaries have separate filenames so earlier provenance stays verifiable.

The native route supplies its supported status/message; paired wrapper output
supplies finite-flux evidence only. Numerical parity, direct signed-flux origin,
physical admissibility and candidate acceptance remain separate conclusions.
Nothing changes the selected model, guard, training inputs or physical contract.
This entry records the failed execution and correction; no artifacts were
synchronized externally.

**What's next.** Audit the corrected collection before drawing physics conclusions.
